gatoh.model.model.ABModel.add_graph

ABModel.add_graph(graph: Graph) → GraphSet[source]

Add a new Graph to the Model’s GraphSet. It is assumed that this is a generated Graph object which already has a name and rw_params assigned to it.

Parameters:

graph (Graph) – The graph to be added to the Model’s GraphSet.

Returns:

The model’s newly updated graph set.

Return type:

GraphSet
